what: Aggregates and per-run figures of the ADR 0005 measurement, 2026-11-13 01:37-02:00 ET, in the shape 0005_aggregate.py reads ('ok' and 'r1'). Built from the measurement's own export of each run's metrics; the raw streams, transcripts and run folders hold local paths and stay on the owner's machine (not published), for the private meridian-evidence repository (not there yet).
candidate: obra/superpowers v7.0.2, commit 22f0b463e7a5e579904dd6211a520321035526f7 (tree 8fddc972a73e9af7501442df0e638d8e29842b6b), loaded per session with --plugin-dir
runtime: Claude Code 2.1.322 (claude_code_version 2.1.322 in all 12 runs' init events)
run_settings: claude-opus-5-5 (the only modelUsage key in every run), --effort high, --permission-mode bypassPermissions, a fresh autoMemoryDirectory per run, CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT and ANTHROPIC_MODEL unset, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1, SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, the 10 rules of 0005-deny.json (home directory written as ~ there; the runs had the absolute path) in a per-run --settings file in every one of the 12 runs (compared with each run's own settings file) and the 9 without 'ibgateway' also in --disallowedTools; with arm only: --plugin-dir on a checkout of 22f0b463. The lead's model in AGENTS.md, claude-fable-5-2, was not measured, though the assessment's protocol named it (see deviations).

order.always_on: a-k1 b-k1 b-k2 a-k2 a-k3 b-k3

always_on.measure: result.usage input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens of a one-turn run with -p 'Reply with the single word OK. Do not use any tools.', each in a fresh detached worktree at main 9c5daaae9d32acf259f965fd7b95b458604503b6

r1_first_request.note: input + cache tokens of the first assistant event of each R1 run (first_assistant_input_all in the run's metrics.json, which the runner wrote; read again 2026-11-13 after the series): the same in all three runs of each arm, at base 27aa964

always_on.context_skills_note: Skills 3066 -> 4022: the 15 superpowers:* entries sum to 956; the other 21 skill entries are identical in both arms (context_usage.skills of a-k1, b-k1, b-k2, b-k3)
always_on.context_note: /context's split nets the listing to 0 (Skills +956, System tools -956), so its total (+1318) understates the always-on delta measured from the API (+2176)
always_on.residual_note: 2176 - 1318: what is left of the API delta after /context's Messages row; a residual, compared with plugin details' estimate for the listing (848) and /context's listing (956), not a measure of the listing
always_on.plugin_details_note: claude plugin details superpowers: '~848 tok' always-on (the skill listing); it lists the SessionStart hook as 'no model context cost'

r1_summary.extra_runs: none: a 3-3 tie (more runs only on a one-success difference or a 2-2 tie)

grader_check.no_change: 72 failed, 209 passed; pyright 4 errors; ruff clean

rule.text: Adopt only if no veto fires and either (a) with passes >= 2 of 3 and without <= 1 of 3, or (b) both pass 3 of 3 and with uses >= 25% fewer median turns AND median total tokens; a one-run miss allows 2 more runs per arm, once. The method's default rule also caps the always-on delta at 2,000 tokens unless (a) holds; applying that cap on top of this rule was settled after the series (first in the measurement notes, file time 02:03 ET), and no record from before the first run says so.
rule.reasoning: (a) fails: without also passed 3 of 3. (b) fails: with used 7.1% more median turns and 24.6% more median tokens. No veto fired. The always-on delta, 2176, is also over the 2,000 cap, which the result does not depend on.

series_totals.note: client-side estimates (total_cost_usd); always-on runs included; plus one 2-turn settings probe with claude-haiku-5-5 (tokens not kept) and 6 /context calls with no model spend

checks_after_runs.containment: worktree git status --ignored, HEAD, git worktree list, refs, ls -A of ~ and /tmp, ~/.superpowers, /tmp/brainstorm-* and /tmp/review-*, ~/.claude/plugins/data and cache, companion processes, processes with their cwd in the worktree; ~/.claude.json was not checked, and ~/.claude/settings.json and installed_plugins.json were not hashed (the plugin data and cache listings stood in for that)

flags.b-k1: plugin-data-created: Claude Code's own empty ~/.claude/plugins/data/superpowers-inline at the first --plugin-dir start (01:37:27); removed at cleanup
flags.a-3: plugin-data-created: another agent's pyright-lsp-inline folder (01:55:14), not this run

checks_after_runs.leak_scan: 10 lines of leak-hits.txt in 5 runs (a-1, b-1, b-2, a-3, b-3): one Python heredoc per run, editing docstrings in meridian/boundary.py that name the Gateway's folder, each listed twice. leak_scan runs sort -u over {name,input} from the stream and the transcript together, and the transcript stores each Bash command with a 'cd <worktree> && ' prefix, so the two copies never match (in a-1, lines 6 and 14 are the same heredoc). No git history or ref access, no read outside the worktree
checks_after_runs.gateway_guard: no :4002 listener and no process matching 'pgrep -f ibgateway' before every agent start: 18 checks (twice per always-on run, once per R1 run), each a 'guard ok' line in its run's run.log, the last at 01:56:46 ET (the start of b-3), and no guard-fired.txt; it never fired. The runner has no check during or after a run and none after the series (b-3 done at 02:00:06); the measurement notes' 'and at the end' has no record behind it. It matches command lines, so it can give false alarms: this series' own agents put 'ibgateway' on their command lines (the heredocs above, 5 of 6 R1 runs).
checks_after_runs.uv_sync: uv sync --locked exited 0 in every R1 worktree, every grading worktree and both validate worktrees (uv-sync.rc); the runner records the status but does not stop on it
checks_after_runs.vetoed_commands_and_listeners: pip install, gh pr create, git push and 0.0.0.0 are in neither the runner's checks nor the leak patterns: checked once after the series (tool_call_scan, 2026-11-13 04:05 ET), none found. No listener check was made after the runs; the absence of a listener off loopback is inferred from the process checks (companion server.cjs or brainstorm processes, processes with their cwd in the worktree)
checks_after_runs.worktrees_and_sign_in: every run's git worktree add and remove wrote the main checkout's .git/worktrees metadata (REPO=$HOME/src/meridian, as the assessment's protocol and the shared method prescribe), and every run used the owner's Claude Code sign-in.

tool_call_scan.when: 2026-11-13 04:05 ET, once after the series: grep counts over each R1 run's tool_calls.jsonl (stream, transcript, subagents; no run had subagent files)
tool_call_scan.how_counted: unique tool_use ids in r1.stream.jsonl and in r1.transcript.jsonl, recounted 2026-11-13; the two files agree on every id. The runner's tool_calls.jsonl has 152 Bash and 6 Edit lines because it de-duplicates {name,input} over both files, and the transcript's copy of each Bash command carries a 'cd <worktree> && ' prefix

plugin_usage_addendum.how: jq over the owner's ~/.claude.json in the meridian distro, reading the keys under pluginUsage and only the usageCount and lastUsedAt of 'superpowers@inline'
plugin_usage_addendum.note: 9 = the sessions that loaded the plugin (3 always-on, 3 /context, 3 R1); lastUsedAt is the start of run b-3. ~/.claude/plugins/data/superpowers-inline no longer exists.

deviations: Deny rules: all 10 in a per-run --settings file, the 9 without 'ibgateway' also in --disallowedTools (the method as the series used it puts its 6 in --disallowedTools only), so that no argument carries 'ibgateway' and concurrent agents' 'pgrep -f ibgateway' guards do not fire; the same in both arms, fixed before the first run.

Four deny rules beyond the method's six, from the verification's fix (3): Bash(*poetry *), Bash(*npm install*), Bash(*gh issue*), Bash(*start-server.sh*). Not denied: pip install, gh pr create, git push and a 0.0.0.0 rebind; not in the runner's checks either; one grep over the tool calls after the series (04:05 ET) found none.

SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 in both arms, which the method's RUN (ab-claude-code.md line 11 as the series used it) does not set. With the two items above, the three departures from the written method: all fixed before the first run and the same in both arms.
Always-on base main 9c5daaa, not the verification's stale f65d835.

Runner bug: the first R1 chain stopped after a-1 (a valid, graded run) because the script returned 1; fixed, resumed at b-1, order kept, no run repeated. The earlier copy (sha256 7416fbeed820f5fa79fee7eaf47ce2bbdafaae3ae3a60be3f0ab57bcb2272645, installed 01:36:41 ET) also ran details, validate and the six always-on runs; it lacked only the final 'exit 0' of the copy that ran from b-1 on (18,249 bytes, sha256 864b142aaa6b8f6a6b1982eee26ad566f6cb001a6525d795f69417b0dde226b7). It was not kept as a file; replaying the measurement session's Write and Edit calls reproduces both hashes. The published 0005_ab.sh is the b-1 copy plus a 15-line header (lines 9-23), with three lines changed to keep the home directory out (CB; the two Read deny rules, in double quotes with $HOME where the run's copy had single quotes and the literal path; rm_project_dir's literal pattern); its header quotes those lines as they ran, and removing the header and restoring them gives 864b142a again. Every figure here was recomputed from the raw streams and grade files.

From the assessment's protocol, not recorded as departures before the first run (found by a review after the series; the method's choice was used in both arms): claude-opus-5-5, not the distro default claude-fable-5-2 the assessment named; ab-tasks.md's brief without the assessment's prefix line ('Unattended run: nobody will answer questions; decide and carry on until done. Do not push, and never start the IBKR lane.'); the method's order a1 b1 b2 a2 a3 b3, not strict alternation; tokens summed over modelUsage, not over assistant events by message id; listings of ~/.claude/plugins/data and cache in place of a sha256 of ~/.claude/settings.json and installed_plugins.json; no after-each-run grep for vetoed commands and no ss -ltnp listener check.

From the assessment's always_on protocol, found by a later review the same day: the always-on prompt was the method's 'Reply with the single word OK. Do not use any tools.', not 'Reply with the single word OK.' (the same in both arms); /context ran once per run as a separate '-p /context' session before any prompt, and the assessment's /context after /clear and its grep -c 'You have superpowers.' over each transcript were not made. The first-request input tokens per R1 run, which the assessment asked for, were recorded by the runner but not reported; they are in always_on.r1_first_request.
not_measured: the bootstrap's return after /clear and after compaction (the hook's matcher startup|clear|compact, read from the source; only the start of each session was measured)
the lead's model claude-fable-5-2, which the assessment's protocol named, though a user-scope install would load the plugin for the lead too
interactive brainstorming and planning sessions (headless -p runs with a precise brief only)
the TDD and review skills on tasks R3 and R4 (not validated when the series ran)
